svg.text: Figure 3.7 Level-2 Data Flow Diagram - Onboarding
Template matching, checklist instantiation, ownership routing and chasing
offset into a real dated task
people at seed time; else unassigned
items produce one message, not four
an unfinished count is stated in both
the confirmation and the audit log
Statutory deadlines bypass the offset builder entirely - a legal due date is a date, not 'day 3'.
